visualCompatibility.basis: Two figures were recaptured from the packaged 2.8.0 app: the welcome screen, for its version number, and the docked Video Output settings, which gained Picture sync under Picture framing. The top bar's small picture of the output was removed, but no figure shows it. The other figures show controls that did not change and keep their earlier captures. All in the dark theme on an Apple silicon Mac; nothing was captured on Windows.
